messages:
elaine: Heads up - noticed ~400 orphaned roles after yesterday's RBAC rename + SSO change. SCIM bulk job created duplicates in prod.

mohit: ugh. any errors in the SCIM logs? did the IdP flip NameID format or claim mapping?

elaine: scim job trace: trace=abc123-prod-sync. Logs show a bunch of KMS unwrap failures when trying to normalize external_id. snippet: ```ERROR scim/handler.go: decrypt envelope failed: kms:InvalidCiphertext\nuser=acct:okta:alice extid=3f4a...```

jack: that KMS error usually means the service attempted to unwrap with an old alias after a rotation. Did infra rotate the alias last night?

sre-ops: we did an alias swap in eu-prod at 03:10 UTC for the new rekey. I didn't think the SCIM service used that alias directly — checking service role bindings and key policy now.

mohit: my hypothesis: two simultaneous changes: (1) IdP changed NameID from transient -> persistent (so external_id hashes differ/casing change), (2) KMS unwrap failed, so our dedupe/canonicalization path couldn't resolve the previous extid -> created new role entries.

elaine: repro on staging: before extid canonicalized to "user|okta|abc123". After IdP change we got "user|okta|ABC123" and when KMS returned InvalidCiphertext we fell back to raw extid -> mismatch -> new role created.

securitybot: audit: recorded ~398 role.create events between 03:12-03:40 UTC tied to trace=abc123-prod-sync. Marking HIGH because it affects entitlements. @compliance FYI.

jack: short remediation plan: (A) fix KMS permissions so unwrap succeeds, (B) re-run SCIM reconcile in staging with the same trace to confirm idempotency, (C) run prune script to merge duplicates.

mohit: pragmatic immediate mitigation: add a pre-check in SCIM worker: if KMS unwrap fails, do not create/attach roles; instead mark record as "needs_manual_reconcile" and emit audit event. I'll draft a small PR to gate creation on unwrap success.

elaine: I'll export sample user list (10 users) that hit the duplicate path and make a backfill CSV for the prune step.

sre-ops: infra note: the alias swap pushed a policy without scim-service-role:Decrypt on the new alias due to a terraform drift. Patching now, ETA ~15-25m.

jack: after infra patch, run this in staging first: ```./bin/scim-reconcile --trace abc123-prod-sync --dry-run``` watch for duplicate creation. If good, run without --dry-run and then prune with: ```python tools/prune_dupes.py --trace abc123-prod-sync --confirm```

mohit: I'll also add a lightweight normalization step that lowercases the IdP-provided NameID before hashing so casing flips don't create new normalized keys. Need to run some evals first.

elaine: action items: 1) infra fixes KMS policy (sre-ops) 2) moh-it opens PR to gate on unwrap + lowercase normalization 3) I produce CSV + run reconcile + prune (jack + elaine) 4) compliance notified and will get an audit window (securitybot).

sre-ops: KMS policy patched and propagated to alias alias/keys/eu-prod-main. Confirmed policy includes scim-service-role:Decrypt now.

jack: good. re-run dry-run in prod-staging now. sharing logs in #eng-sre if anything odd.

mohit: PR #8421 created with unwrap-gate + lowercasing normalization. Requesting review from jack and elaine.

elaine: I'll wait for infra confirmation then kick off reconcile. tagging @jack when ready.

deploy-bot: deployment queued for PR #8421 by moh-it - expected deploy in ~45m :rocket:

jack: ping me when reconcile completes, I'll run prune and sanity-check audit counts before we close INC-2025.

elaine: TL;DR: RBAC rename + IdP NameID change + KMS alias rotation + missing Decrypt permission caused SCIM to create duplicate roles. Fixing KMS policy and adding unwrap-fail-safe + normalization should prevent recurrence. Will follow up with postmortem. :thumbsup:
